verdict.rationale: FireHydrant publishes an API reference section (docs.firehydrant.com/reference/firehydrant-api) describing an API that covers anything possible in the UI, with documented token-based API-key auth. Nothing in the evidence shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec at common paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive 'try it' functionality, runnable code examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
